We consider bound state solutions to the time-independent Schrödinger equation
(TISE) that are not piecewise constant in this section. Examples include the
delta function potential, the quantum bouncer, and the harmonic oscillator. The
harmonic oscillator is also described using the operator formalism.

in three dimensions. Examples include a particle in a 3D box, Schrödinger’s
equation in spherical coordinates and the hydrogen radial wavefunctions.
